title: A surgeon explains: Will Malik Nabers' shoulder injury limit his impact, and what's the reinjury risk?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: A surgeon explains: Will Malik Nabers' shoulder injury limit his impact, and what's the reinjury risk?
sources.description: Lost in the shuffle on Monday night after Giants QB Jaxson Dart went down with a knee injury against the Rams was the brief absence of Malik Nabers, who crumpled to the field in pain with a right shoulder injury shortly after Dart's exit.
